message_excerpt: NIFI-16154 Aligned Asset Owner ID checking in Delete and Get methods (#11485)
proposition: DELETE /parameter-contexts/{contextId}/assets/{assetId}: contract says the operation deletes an asset from the given parameter context; implementation does verification checks references in the given context but deletion uses the asset ID alone without verifying its owner context
